profile_summary.name: Meera
profile_summary.bmi_note: BMI slightly exceeds standard normal ranges, but as a trained individual, body composition and waist circumference are superior proxies for fatness.
profile_summary.goal: Fat loss: keep the muscle and the strength
profile_summary.bmr_equation: Mifflin-St Jeor: 10 x 72 kg + 6.25 x 168 cm - 5 x 32 years - 161 = 1449 kcal
profile_summary.activity_factor_note: Base factor 1.4 for 5000 steps plus 0.075 for 3 training days per week.
profile_summary.calorie_adjustment_note: Target set at a 444 kcal daily deficit below TDEE, aiming for 0.5 to 1.0 percent body weight loss per week. Adjust by 100 to 150 kcal every 2 weeks based on the 7-day average weight trend.
assumptions: Height parsed as 168 cm and weight as 72 kg.
Age computed from date of birth 1993-11-04 relative to current date 2026-09-25.

weekly_split.frequency_rationale: A 3-day full body split hits every major muscle group 3 times per week, distributing volume optimally for an intermediate lifter while fitting the 3-day availability constraint.
weekly_split.scheduling_note: Train on non-consecutive days, such as Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, to allow 48 hours of recovery between sessions.

protocol: Hold the load constant until all working sets reach the top of the rep range at 2 RIR.
Increase load by 2.5 kg for upper body or 5 kg for lower body once the top rep target is met.
Log every session and body weight daily to track progress accurately.
progressive_overload.load_increments: 2.5 kg for upper body lifts, 5 kg for lower body barbell lifts.
progressive_overload.deload: Reduce working sets by half and lower load by 15 percent every 6 weeks to dissipate accumulated fatigue.
progressive_overload.tracking: Log all sets, reps, and loads. Track morning body weight daily.

quality_vs_quantity.stance: Execution quality dictates muscle retention and growth.
quality_vs_quantity.why: Sets performed with momentum or stopped far from failure fail to stimulate adaptation while adding systemic fatigue.
practical_rules: Control the eccentric phase for 2 seconds on every repetition.
Pause briefly at the reversal point without bouncing.
Stop sets at 1 to 3 reps in reserve as prescribed.
Never sacrifice range of motion to add weight.

rationale.exercise_selection: Exercises are selected to target all major muscle groups efficiently using available home barbell and dumbbell equipment.
rationale.ordering: Multi-joint compound movements are placed at the beginning of sessions when neural fatigue is lowest.
rationale.volume_analysis: Provides 12 direct hard sets per major muscle group per week, falling squarely in the intermediate volume landmark band of 10 to 16 sets.
rationale.goal_fit: The moderate calorie deficit combined with heavy resistance training preserves muscle mass and strength during fat loss.

cardio_and_steps.step_rationale: Increasing daily steps by 3000 adds roughly 150 kcal of energy expenditure without impairing recovery.

cardio_sessions.placement: Performed on non-lifting days or post-workout.

cardio_and_steps.interference_note: Low-impact walking at moderate volume has negligible interference with resistance training adaptations.

diet_plan.macro_rationale: Protein is set at 2.0 g per kg of body weight based on Morton et al. 2018 to maximize muscle retention during fat loss. Fat is set at 0.8 g per kg for hormonal health, and carbohydrates fill remaining calories to fuel training.

meal_schedule.timing_note: High protein start to anchor daily intake.
Balanced meal with adequate complex carbohydrates.
Post-workout recovery meal following evening training.

sample_day_totals.note: Equivalent macro swaps using preferred foods are encouraged.

diet_plan.pre_post_workout: Consume a small carbohydrate and protein source 90 minutes before training. Eat a complete mixed meal within 2 hours post-workout.
diet_plan.hydration: Consume 30 to 40 ml of fluids per kg daily, targeting pale straw urine color.
diet_plan.diet_preference_note: Non-veg preference accommodated using chicken, fish, eggs, dairy, dal, and grains.

supplements.name: Creatine Monohydrate
supplements.reason: Enhances high-power output and cellular hydration.
supplements.caveat: Consult a physician if kidney disease is present. Expect minor water retention.

supplements.name: Whey Protein
supplements.reason: Convenient food source to meet daily protein targets.

supplements.name: Caffeine
supplements.reason: Reduces perceived exertion during training sessions.
supplements.caveat: Limit evening doses to protect sleep quality.

supplements_excluded_note: Hormonal agents, fat burners, BCAAs, mass gainers and proprietary blends are excluded due to lack of evidence or safety concerns.

duration_and_paths.duration_rationale: Three months provides sufficient runway for progressive fat loss while preserving lean mass and strength adaptations.
duration_and_paths.review_points: Review scale weight weekly averages and 2-week waist measurements against projected trends.

next_paths.name: Maintenance Phase
next_paths.what_changes: Increase calories to weight maintenance level and progress training volume.

next_paths.name: Further Fat Loss
next_paths.when_to_choose: Additional fat loss desired after initial 3 months
next_paths.what_changes: Maintain deficit or adjust steps upward.

safety_notes.medical_disclaimer: This plan is for informational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice. Stop exercising immediately and seek professional care if you experience chest pain, dizziness, or unusual shortness of breath.
